chapters.title: A tiny language. A big idea.
chapters.narration: Three commands. Thirty puzzles. One tiny robot.

chapters.title: 01 / CODE
chapters.narration: Turn a few lines of code into a beautiful path. Every byte counts.

chapters.title: 02 / DEBUG
chapters.narration: Run it. Pause it. Step through each move. See your thinking come to life.

chapters.title: 03 / GROW
chapters.narration: Start simple. Learn procedures, parameters, and recursion. Then take on the cathedral.

chapters.title: 04 / EXPLORE
chapters.narration: Modern boards. Classic charm. Learn from the guide, and save your progress offline.

chapters.title: 05 / AI BATTLEFIELD
chapters.narration: Meet AI Battlefield. Bring your own models. Same puzzles. Same rules. Compare solutions with a real puzzle judge.

chapters.title: THINK IN PATTERNS
chapters.narration: Think smaller. Solve bigger. Herbot Bot. How elegant is your solution?
